Pick your strength days. The walking fills in around them.

Every week in the app is built from three things: strength training, 150 minutes of walking, and recovery. You choose how many days you lift.

Get a week built for you

What’s inside a week

Six kinds of class, so a busy Tuesday and a free Saturday both have something that fits.

  • Sculpt

    Strength with dumbbells, sliders and bands.

  • Barre

    High reps, pulses and isometric holds.

  • Cardio

    Walking, plus optional HIIT twice a week with low- and high-impact options.

  • Express

    Shorter versions of the full-length workouts.

  • Deep Core

    Pilates-based core work, built into every workout.

  • Mobility

    Opens and closes every class.

Moves from this week’s classes

The program grew up with its members

  1. About 20 years ago

    Moms Into Fitness starts with postpartum recovery, Pilates, pelvic floor health and getting strong again after a baby.

  2. Her members get older

    The women who started with Lindsay as new moms stay with her into their forties.

  3. Perimenopause changes the plan

    When her own body stopped responding to exercise the way it used to, Lindsay rebuilt the program around strength training, walking and recovery.

Lindsay has a degree in Exercise Science, danced professionally in the NFL and has certified Pilates instructors across the US. She’s a mom of three teenagers. Classes are also taught by Amy J, Amy N and Kendra, and the recipes come from registered dietitian Stephanie M.
